metadata.title: Carbon Continuity After Wildfire: A Dynamic Portfolio Framework and Regenerative Coupling Threshold for Natural Carbon Assets
metadata.description: A model-scoped framework for post-wildfire carbon continuity. The exact two-pool coupling threshold is formally verified in Lean with six frozen zero-sorry theorems and an independent local audit. The manuscript does not claim ecological validation, treatment efficacy, carbon-credit validity, or literature priority.
metadata.notes: Six frozen Lean theorems are independently audited with zero sorry. The numerical checker is portable and provenance-bound; the original concept outline is recorded as provenance and not scientific evidence. No canon admission, peer acceptance, ecological validation, treatment efficacy, carbon-credit validity, or literature priority is asserted.
